No. The evidence covers ASSET-B, not the surrounding region, so it cannot establish whether forest loss occurred region-wide.

Within the asset, the data report historical tree-cover loss before the end of 2020, including 67.7 hectares in 2020. After the baseline, they show 0.4 hectares of loss in small patches in 2021, below the 0.5-hectare event threshold. The JRC dataset identifies no forest on the asset in 2020.
